description: This file defines the ToggleMethodProfilingAction class, which provides an action to toggle method profiling (start/stop) on an Android device client within the Android Studio IDE.

classes.name: ToggleMethodProfilingAction
classes.description: An action class that toggles method profiling (start/stop) for a selected Android client in the IDE.

methods.name: ToggleMethodProfilingAction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the action with project and device context.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Determines if method profiling is currently active for the selected client.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Starts or stops method profiling based on the current status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the action's presentation text and enabled state based on the current client status.
